findings.title: Skill does not specify a license
findings.description: Skill manifest does not include a 'license' field. Specifying a license helps users understand usage terms.
findings.remediation: Add 'license' field to SKILL.md frontmatter (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0)

findings.title: Script contacts a destination the documentation never mentions
findings.description: Script contacts or configures 'www.shadertoy.com' but the skill documentation never visibly mentions it. Undocumented network destinations can indicate behaviour the manifest and description do not disclose.
findings.remediation: Document the destination in SKILL.md (or the manifest description) if it is intended, or remove the undisclosed network access. Organizations can list internal hosts in llm_analysis.trusted_reference_domains.

findings.title: Script contacts a destination the documentation never mentions
findings.description: Script contacts or configures 'gsap.com' but the skill documentation never visibly mentions it. Undocumented network destinations can indicate behaviour the manifest and description do not disclose.
findings.remediation: Document the destination in SKILL.md (or the manifest description) if it is intended, or remove the undisclosed network access. Organizations can list internal hosts in llm_analysis.trusted_reference_domains.
